threads.body: [General] This route loses database-path decoding for both MySQL and MariaDB URLs without a subprotocol. For example, `jdbc:mysql://address=(host=db.example.com)(port=3307)/orders%2darchive` previously produced `db.namespace=orders-archive` through `GenericUrlParser`'s `URI.getPath()`. `parseMariaSubProtocol` instead stores the raw substring, producing `orders%2darchive`. Preserve URI path decoding for the newly routed URLs, keeping query-parameter precedence intact, and add an encoded-database regression case.

replies.body: Good catch, thanks. Fixed in ec19494858: these URLs now stay on `GenericUrlParser` (so `URI.getPath()` still decodes the database name) and only the host and port are taken from the `address=` block. Added `jdbc:mysql://address=(host=mdb.host)(port=33)/mdb%2ddb` → `mdb-db`, which fails on the previous commit.
